description: This file defines message data structures used for communication between components in an Android Cuttlefish frontend system, including control messages, registration, device info, and connection management.

classes.name: ControlMsgHeader
classes.description: Header for control messages indicating message type.

classes.name: PreRegisterMsg
classes.description: Message for pre-registration, including group, owner, and devices.

classes.name: RegistrationStatusReport
classes.description: Report of registration status, including ID, status, and message.

classes.name: PreRegistrationResponse
classes.description: Alias for a slice of RegistrationStatusReport, representing pre-registration responses.

classes.name: RegisterMsg
classes.description: Message sent to register a device, including device ID, port, and info.

classes.name: ConnectMsg
classes.description: Message to establish a connection for a device.

classes.name: ForwardMsg
classes.description: Message containing payload for forwarding, associated with a client ID.

classes.name: ClientMsg
classes.description: General message from or to a client, including type, client ID, and payload.

classes.name: ErrorMsg
classes.description: Error message with error string and optional details.

classes.name: NewConnMsg
classes.description: Message indicating a new connection request with device ID.

classes.name: NewConnReply
classes.description: Reply to new connection request, including connection ID and device info.

classes.name: InfraConfig
classes.description: Configuration message for ICE servers used in connectivity.

classes.name: IceServer
classes.description: Details about an ICE server, including URLs, username, and credentials.

classes.name: DeviceDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor for device information in registration and discovery.

classes.name: DeviceInfoReply
classes.description: Reply containing device descriptor and registration info.

methods.name: json:"message_type"
methods.description: JSON field for message type in control headers.

methods.name: json:"id"
methods.description: JSON field for device or registration ID.

methods.name: json:"device_info"
methods.description: JSON field for device info, flexible structured data.

methods.name: json:"device_info"
methods.description: JSON field for device info in reply.

methods.name: json:"message_type"
methods.description: JSON field for message type in InfraConfig.

methods.name: json:"ice_servers"
methods.description: JSON field for list of ICE servers.

methods.name: json:"urls"
methods.description: JSON field listing URLs for ICE server.

methods.name: json:"username,omitempty"
methods.description: Optional JSON field for ICE server username.

methods.name: json:"credential,omitempty"
methods.description: Optional JSON field for ICE server credential.
